import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    private static final int MAXN = 210;
    private static final int MAXM = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;
    private static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    private static final int INF = 2000000000;
    private static final int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    private static final int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    private static final int S = MAXN - 2;
    private static final int T = MAXN - 1;

    static class MaxFlow {
        int[] to = new int[MAXM];
        int[] flow = new int[MAXM];
        int[] cap = new int[MAXM];
        int lastEdge;

        ArrayList<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[MAXN];
        boolean[] used = new boolean[MAXN];

        MaxFlow() {
            lastEdge = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int fr, int t, int c) {
            to[lastEdge] = t;
            flow[lastEdge] = 0;
            cap[lastEdge] = c;
            g[fr].add(lastEdge++);

            to[lastEdge] = fr;
            flow[lastEdge] = 0;
            cap[lastEdge] = 0;
            g[t].add(lastEdge++);
        }

        boolean dfs(int v, int target, int curFlow) {
            if (v == target) {
                return true;
            }
            used[v] = true;
            for (int idx : g[v]) {
                int next = to[idx];
                if (!used[next] && cap[idx] - flow[idx] >= curFlow && dfs(next, target, curFlow)) {
                    flow[idx] += curFlow;
                    flow[idx ^ 1] -= curFlow;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int getMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            int curFlow = 1 << 30;
            int resFlow = 0;
            while (curFlow > 0) {
                if (dfs(source, sink, curFlow)) {
                    resFlow += curFlow;
                } else {
                    curFlow >>= 1;
                }
                Arrays.fill(used, false);
            }
            return resFlow;
        }
    }

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] b = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] dist = new int[15][15];
    static boolean[][] used = new boolean[15][15];
    static MaxFlow maxFlow = new MaxFlow();

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < n && 0 <= y && y < n && a[x][y] != 'Y' && a[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsDeath(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
        }
        Queue<Integer> qx = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new ArrayDeque<>();
        dist[x][y] = 0;
        qx.add(x);
        qy.add(y);
        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int curx = qx.poll();
            int cury = qy.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = curx + dx[k];
                int ty = cury + dy[k];
                if (ok(tx, ty) && dist[tx][ty] == INF) {
                    dist[tx][ty] = dist[curx][cury] + 1;
                    qx.add(tx);
                    qy.add(ty);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void runBFS(int x, int y) {
        Queue<Integer> qx = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Queue<Integer> qlev = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(used[i], false);
        }
        used[x][y] = true;
        qx.add(x);
        qy.add(y);
        qlev.add(0);
        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int curx = qx.poll();
            int cury = qy.poll();
            int curlev = qlev.poll();
            if (Character.isDigit(b[curx][cury]) && b[curx][cury] != '0') {
                maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, n * n + 1 + curx * n + cury, INF);
            }
            if (curlev >= t) {
                continue;
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = curx + dx[k];
                int ty = cury + dy[k];
                if (ok(tx, ty) && !used[tx][ty]) {
                    if (dist[tx][ty] > curlev + 1) {
                        qx.add(tx);
                        qy.add(ty);
                        qlev.add(curlev + 1);
                    } else if (dist[tx][ty] > curlev && Character.isDigit(b[tx][ty]) && b[tx][ty] != '0') {
                        maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, n * n + 1 + tx * n + ty, INF);
                    }
                    used[tx][ty] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void build() {
        int posi = -1, posj = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && posi == -1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n && posi == -1; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    posi = i;
                    posj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        bfsDeath(posi, posj);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(S, i * n + j, a[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(b[i][j]) && b[i][j] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(i * n + j + n * n + 1, T, b[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0') {
                    runBFS(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        build();
        System.out.println(maxFlow.getMaxFlow(S, T));
    }
}
